scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with explicit assumptions, Laplace expansion and additive-relation phase argument; computational evidence is only a check.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite integer frequency sets and sufficiently large even exponents. No uniform-in-bandwidth threshold; asymptotic errors are aperture-dependent. Numerical checks corroborate but do not replace proof. Historical priority remains provisional pending independent expert literature review.
title: Gaussian high-exponent law and amplitude drift for finite Fourier apertures
